steps: Echo of Hearts and Stars (Part III)
In the gentle night, Caramel plucks the strings of her bass and the hearts of the troubled Trekkers. The legend of Flavio is thus born.
Through the mist, the city's bright lights still shimmer in the distance.
But out here, there's no harsh smoke, only the soft scent of grass and wildflowers.
The Trekkers and Caramel's devoted fans sit together under the starry sky.
Right now, the earth itself is the stage.
And the Monolith's faint glow is the spotlight cheering on the performer.
Yeah. I figured you'd feel more at home in a place like this.
Miss Caramel, once the opening act wraps up,==W== it'll be your turn to take the stage.
Yes... I'll give it everything I've got!
So many people came today... Not to mention there's also the Monolith, the earth, the sky, the moon...==W== And you, Producer.
Yup. I'll listen with all my heart.
Using Caramel's music to heal the Trekkers' mental scars...
And using this experience to let Caramel better understand their inner worlds and feelings...
I guess I'm a cunning producer.
The mellow sound of the bass cuts through the night sky.
Time, once the cage that traps those Trekkers, begins to flow again.
Ugh... My body... Every time I see a Monolith, I just go limp... What's wrong with me?
… If a Stellaroid or some monster shows up... We wouldn't be able to fight back like this... Performing here is very dangerous, isn't it?
I lower my voice as much as I can, trying to ease the tension in those anxious whispers.
Close your eyes and focus! Miss Caramel is doing everything she can to help us...
I'm sorry, but... Does this really work? I mean, it's just music... Right?
It's as if it's beating in sync with my heartbeat.
… Now that you mention it, that low boomy sound...
It sounds just like the footsteps you hear when walking on the Monolith...
I don't really know that much about music.
But I do get the emotion contained in this melody.
There's a hint of sorrow in it—gentle, yet cathartic.==W== It feels like... Remembrance.
Just listening to it takes you back...
I see. So the theme Caramel came up with is "the past."
The past... The Flavio that used to be. Those early adventures.
Will the Trekkers remember why they set out on their journey in the first place?
At times like this, it's more about just feeling the music rather than trying to make sense of it.
With that in mind, I stop overanalyzing whether it's working. After all, feelings aren't something you can break down and dissect.
The night's only just begun, but the music's already filling the camp with a gentle warmth.
… How did I let fear get such a hold over me...
… I remember now... The reason I first wanted to become a Trekker—it was because...
Looks like they're starting to pull themselves together.
Time keeps ticking, but no one wants to leave the moment.
The show is an unprecedented success.
Without even inviting any Witch to report it, the show we pulled off together somehow made it into Flavio's newspapers and even turned into an urban legend.
Caramel's probably going to be even more famous after this... ==W==Not that she cares about that kind of thing.
Time flies.==W== A few days later, Caramel's dragging me off on another "inspiration journey."
Just thinking about that performance gets me all excited again!
It's been so long since I've had that much fun playing! The inspiration just keeps flowing!
I'm so relieved to hear that.
It's all thanks to you, Producer!
Every time Caramel praises me like that, I can't help but feel a little embarrassed...
Producer... Was it really just a coincidence that you picked me for this commission?
No way! It's because your music always draws me in, Caramel!
A little flustered, she punches me gently.==W== Ah, the strong fists of a true musician again.
You've always said that music is meant to express things, right?
Yes... With music, I can express my inner landscape...
And then... I can talk...with the Monoliths.
Actually, the inner landscapes of different people can also be shared, exchanged, and even blended. That's how it's supposed to be.
Yeah... I understand that now. It's been a truly rare and valuable lesson.
Haha, if anything, it's people like you—who can express themselves to the earth, the ocean, the Monoliths, the sky... You're the rare kind.
You're making it sound like I'm amazing or something.
That's because you are amazing... And not just that, either. You understood their pain so quickly.
With just your music, you got them to let their guard down, to face their fears and reconnect with the dreams they started out with.
I heard... No, I saw those landscapes.
Even though they didn't say a word, I could still feel their sadness. It's like they left something behind in the Monolith.
That part of them they left behind in the Monolith... I heard it, saw it. I tried to listen to it.==W== And that was the song that came to me.
Your music has the power to echo deep in people's hearts. It's strong enough to move the soul.
She lets go and spins around, hugging her bass close.
Say... I haven't thank you properly yet, Producer!
Don't say that. You played a huge part in this inspiration journey!
Thanks for also spending all this time with me today! I've got so much inspiration flowing right now!
Producer, can I play something just for you?==W== Think of it as … a little summary of all the inspiration I've gathered lately.
The moment she starts talking about performing, she sounds excited again.
Looks like today's inspiration journey isn't over yet...==W== As the producer, I've got to see it through.
Not far from here is the "music space" she often goes to.
Her strong hand takes mine as she leads me up the steps by the back door...
Upstairs is Caramel's own space. Her little corner of freedom.
It's incredibly strange, but... ==W==You know how you're always there for me at EXACTLY the right time?==W==
I was wondering... ==W==Could it be that you've heard the Monolith Notes, too?==W==
Yeah! ==W==You've been through the Monolith lots of times. ==W==You must have heard them, right?
Those strange sounds ==W==that seem to echo endlessly...
Now that you mention it, I do remember a kind of music...
They say the Monolith is where dreams come true and wishes are granted! ==W====W==So I started wondering if the Monolith Notes were made of people's wishes!==W==
And I've been chasing them ever ==W==since that idea came into my head!==W==
I hope one day to join the Monolith ==W==and make beautiful music with it!==W==
Dream big or go home, right! ♪
Um, so, as I was saying... ==W==You know everything about the Monolith, ==W==you're super positive, ==W==and you always understand me...==W==
And that's exactly why you're the only one who can be my producer!==W====W==
Well, since you put it that way...
Let's see what we can do together
Wow... ♪ ==W==Thank you so much! ==W==You'll see! ==W==One day I'll solve the mystery of the Monolith Notes with you by my side!==W==
The fragrant scent still lingers in the air, and the neon lights still shimmer brightly.
Above this swaying city, her bass rings out bright and clear, cutting through the night.
